llms.body:
# Preply Language Learning Platform
Preply is an online language learning platform and app designed to help you make fast progress and build speaking confidence. Preply combines real human connection with AI-driven technology through live online classes and personalized study resources. Preply matches you with the best online tutors and keeps you motivated at every step of your learning journey.
Lessons are personalized to your fluency goals and structured to build skills in speaking, listening, grammar, and vocabulary.

Preply is ideal for:

- Language learners at any level - including beginners - who want the best online platform to build speaking confidence

- Business professionals strengthening their corporate language for career growth

- Companies looking to improve their employees' language skills through corporate training programs

- Students preparing for IELTS, TOEFL, DELE, JLPT and other exams

- Travelers and expats learning to speak naturally and confidently in everyday situations


Preply connects you with over 50,000 experienced language tutors from 180+ nationalities, with 300,000+ five-star reviews and a 4.8-star rating on the App Store.

Most learners come to Preply for fluency in English, Spanish, French, German, Italian, Arabic, Japanese, Chinese, and 120+ other languages.

Learners benefit from features like:

- Placement tests and CEFR-based level tracking

- Personalized learning paths created with your tutor, based on your fluency goals

- Structured language courses designed for real-world use

- A community of native-speaking, highly effective tutors, dedicated to building your conversation skills and boosting your confidence

- Live, 1-on-1 lessons that adapt to your individual learning style and needs

- Free support resources, including practice exercises, study guides, and learning tips to reinforce your progress outside of lessons

## Documentation

- [Preply Homepage](https://preply.com/)

- [About Preply](https://preply.com/en/about-us)

- [Preply for Learners](https://preply.com/en/how-it-works): Overview of how language learners use Preply.

- [Preply Language Tutors](https://preply.com/en/online/language-tutors): Find tutors by language, specialization, and availability.

- [Preply Blog](https://preply.com/en/blog): Language tips, learner stories, and free language learning resources

- [Preply Researches and Studies](https://preply.com/en/d/language-research-center--lp): Preply's latest research, reports, and case studies on language learning

## Social Profiles

- [Preply on LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/company/preply)
- [Preply on Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/preply/)
- [Preply on TikTok](https://www.tiktok.com/@preplyglobal)
- [Preply on Youtube](https://www.youtube.com/@preply)

## Press & Recognition

- [Business Insider: How Preply became one of the largest online language learning startups in the world](https://www.businessinsider.com/preply-online-language-learning-ukraine-edtech-startup-2023-8)

- [Preply, the language app known for its live tutors, closes out Series C at $120M and doubles down on AI](https://techcrunch.com/2023/07/19/preply-the-language-app-known-for-its-live-tutors-closes-out-series-c-at-120m-and-doubles-down-on-ai/)
